Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from our side after syncing with the security team:

- Owners: confirmed — Aurelia Security (security@aurelia.tech) will own completion of the questionnaire and evidence collection. Procurement will coordinate contract/redlines and invoice timing.
- Dates: SOC2 questionnaire by 2026-11-27 is tight for our security reviewer. Can we move evidence delivery to 2026-12-12 and target close to 2026-12-20 instead? That gives our security team time to validate artifacts.
- Deliverables: please include a mapping doc (controls -> Redwood product areas), a redacted SOC 2 report sample (we need to see scoping and user data redaction approach), system/data flow diagram, and SSO/KM (key management) details.

Also — are there any outstanding items that require a legal NDA or DPA amendment before we share evidence with your team? Procurement is copied and will advise.
